scenes.title: KTH Robot Design Prototyping Room
scenes.institution: Kth Royal Institute Of Technology — Robot Design Lab mechatronic prototyping room
scenes.reference_notes: Real workroom contains an instrumented assembly bench below dense hand-tool pegboards and component bins. Several enclosed desktop printers and an open-frame printer stand along a window-side workbench. Central workstations contain clamped mechanical extrusions, prototype parts, electronics and monitor arms. This is a hands-on prototyping laboratory with physical tools, printers and assembly fixtures, not a generic computer office. Exact printer model, unseen room perimeter and prototype dimensions are unverified. People and screen contents must not be copied into the scene.
